newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss KOF forecasts 0.3 pct GDP growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Swiss KOF forecasts 0.3 pct GDP growth in 1997.

text.p: The economic research department (KOF) of the Swiss Federal Institution of Technology is forecasting a 0.3 percent increase in the Swiss gross domestic product in 1997, and a 1.6 percent increase in 1998, according to its spring forecast released on Tuesday.
It also foresees only a slight increase in the domestic inflation rate to 1.0 percent in 1997 from 0.8 percent in 1996. It sees a 1.2 percent inflation rate in 1998.
It expected continued weakness in the labour market.
It forecast the unemployment rate to reach an annual average of 5.7 percent in 1997 and 6.0 percent in 1998, compared with 4.7 percent in 1996.
"In the course of the forecast period, unemployment will rise sharply in 1997 and then stabilise at approximately 6.0 percent from mid-1998 onwards," it said.
